items.title: Why Coinbase (COIN) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of blockchain infrastructure company Coinbase (NASDAQ:COIN) jumped 7.4% in the morning session after investors bid crypto names on fresh optimism around the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, CoinDesk reported, with bitcoin also higher. CoinDesk put bitcoin at about $71,936, up roughly 2% over 24 hours — so some of Coinbase bid was crypto beta, but COIN still outran the coin on a policy premium. The catalyst was not a vote.
